why: Pause-only viewing cues as data (fia-easy-button-policy@2 flow.cue.pauseOnly). Named fallback for the pack.json flag: pack.json bytes are the hash-pinned approved presentation (library.js:7 revision, server/fia/publication/trusted-approved-presentation.json sha256), so the flag lives beside it, keyed by presentation id. Debt: retires when packs carry activity.flow.cue from the server projector.
